name: @pipeworx/mcp-rentcast

tools.name: search_rental_listings
tools.description: Search ACTIVE rental listings — individual homes and apartments currently for rent in the US, from RentCast's listing feed. Filter by city+state, ZIP code, or a latitude/longitude radius, plus bedrooms, bathrooms, and property type. Returns each listing's address, monthly rent, beds/baths, square footage, and listing date. Note: bedrooms/bathrooms filters are exact-match (e.g. bedrooms 3 returns only 3-bed homes; for "3-4 beds" call twice). This is the tool for "find homes/apartments for rent near X" — unlike area rent statistics (HUD Fair Market Rents) or single-address rent estimates.

latitude.description: Latitude for radius search (use with longitude and radius_miles)

radius_miles.description: Search radius in miles around latitude/longitude (max 100)

bedrooms.description: Exact number of bedrooms (RentCast matches exactly, not minimum)

bathrooms.description: Exact number of bathrooms (supports halves, e.g. 2.5)

tools.name: get_rent_estimate
tools.description: Get a rental price estimate for a US property address. Returns estimated monthly rent, price range, and comparable rental data. Example: "1234 Main St, Austin, TX 78701".

address.description: Full street address with city, state, and ZIP (e.g., "5500 Grand Lake Dr, San Antonio, TX 78244")

tools.name: get_property
tools.description: Get property details for a US address. Returns bedrooms, bathrooms, square footage, lot size, year built, property type, and owner info when available.

address.description: Full street address with city, state, and ZIP (e.g., "123 Oak Ave, Denver, CO 80202")

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-rentcast forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the rentcast pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
